2607.21685.title: Evaluation design conditions the expert-vs-auto MeSH gap: a controlled comparison of bag-of-words and BiomedBERT on the Cohen benchmark
2607.21685.paper_summary: A systematic review begins with someone reading thousands of abstracts to identify the few that are relevant, and classifiers are used to prioritise that reading. Their inputs are often augmented with Medical Subject Headings (MeSH), assigned either by expert indexers weeks or months after publication or by automatic tools at once. To our knowledge the two have not been compared directly as classifier features, and no previous work has asked whether that comparison's outcome depends on how the classifier is evaluated. Using the Cohen et al. (2006) drug-class benchmark on three topics, we characterise a bag-of-words logistic regression classifier (seven reruns) and BiomedBERT (five seeds), then examine how the Statins result changes under alternative designs. Under the canonical 5-fold full-corpus design, the bag-of-words expert-vs-auto gap on Statins is +0.096 WSS@95%. Matching the corpus size to the smaller topics (n = 803) reduces it to +0.033 (95% bootstrap CI includes zero), and 10-fold cross-validation at full size to +0.021 (CI narrowly excludes zero). Under canonical evaluation BiomedBERT gives +0.020, within sampling noise of the bag-of-words 10-fold result. A power analysis indicates a Statins-sized effect would not have been detectable at the Opioids or ADHD variance, so those nulls are design-limited rather than informative. A representation asymmetry remains: 15.1% of Statins inputs exceed BiomedBERT's 512-token limit when expert MeSH terms are appended, so truncation may contribute to the smaller transformer gap, although this cannot be separated from training volume here. In screening pipelines using transformers or 10-fold bag-of-words, the gap on the topics tested is about 0.02 WSS@95%, with CIs spanning zero on at least one bound. More broadly, benchmark conclusions about feature sources can change substantially under reasonable changes to the evaluation design.
2607.21685.paper_summary_zh: 系統性回顧始於某人閱讀數千篇摘要，以識別出少數相關的摘要，並使用分類器來優先考慮這一閱讀。它們的輸入通常會與醫學主題標題（MeSH）一起增強，這些標題要麼由專家索引者在發表後幾週或幾個月分配，要麼由自動工具立即分配。據我們所知，這兩者尚未作為分類器特徵直接進行比較，且之前的研究沒有探討這種比較的結果是否依賴於分類器的評估方式。使用Cohen等人（2006）在三個主題上的藥物類別基準，我們對一個詞袋邏輯回歸分類器（七次重複）和BiomedBERT（五個種子）進行特徵描述，然後檢查在不同設計下Statins的結果如何變化。在典型的5折全語料庫設計下，詞袋專家與自動的Statins差距為+0.096 WSS@95%。將語料庫大小匹配到較小的主題（n = 803）將其減少到+0.033（95%自助法置信區間包含零），而在全大小的10折交叉驗證下為+0.021（置信區間狹窄地排除零）。在典型評估下，BiomedBERT給出+0.020，與詞袋的10折結果在取樣噪聲範圍內。功效分析表明，Statins大小的效應在Opioids或ADHD的變異中是不可檢測的，因此這些無效結果是設計限制而非資訊性。仍然存在一種表徵不對稱：在附加專家MeSH術語時，15.1%的Statins輸入超過BiomedBERT的512標記限制，因此截斷可能會促成較小的Transformer差距，儘管這在此無法與訓練量分開。在使用Transformer或10折詞袋的篩選管道中，測試主題上的差距約為0.02 WSS@95%，且至少一個邊界的置信區間跨越零。更廣泛地說，關於特徵來源的基準結論在合理的評估設計變更下可能會有顯著變化。
2607.21685.author: Samuel M. Okoe-Mensah et.al.
